title: Disorder and gradients are costs
caption: Same porosity as the ordered fine mesh (11.7 N/m for this lattice registry, 11.7 to 13.3 across registries): positional jitter of 2 Å (11.8 for this seed, 10.4 to 11.8 across seeds), pore-size dispersion (11.3), a Voronoi network (14.4 for this seed, 9.2 to 14.4 across seeds) and a pore-size gradient along the load (10.1, set by its weakest band). None is a toughening mechanism in this model. Screened REBO2, athermal quasi-static uniaxial tension along x; colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV); red rings: atoms that have lost a bond; frames between stored quasi-static states are interpolated. All statements are model results.
